summary: White Peak-made home kit worn in the 2027 World Cup Asian qualifiers (Qatar v China, Al Janoub Arena, 2026-08-27; Japan v Qatar, Tokyo, 2026-08-31). Official QBF and FIBA photos show the shirt carries only the 'QATAR' wordmark, the Qatar flag square, the QBF crest and the PEAK maker mark (also on shorts and socks): no commercial sponsor logo on any visible placement. Not marked complete: the back of the jersey was never visible in an openable photo, and no kit launch or press article describes the shirt, so the PEAK maker attribution is visual only (PEAK is also listed in QBF's own 'Our Sponsors' grid).
